sources.title: microduckapp/microduck-roll-over · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Roll Over Rolls its heavy head round in a slow circle, then turns right over like in bed and droops the other way. A 10.8-second move for the Microduck robot, from the MicroDuck app.

sources.title: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics Releases Small, Cute & Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has introduced Microduck, a small biped robot designed as an open development platform for experimenting with physical AI, reinforcement learning and transferring robot behaviors from simulation into real hardware.

sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source 25 cm Biped You ...
sources.snippet: Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face launch Microduck, a $399 open-source 25 cm biped trained with reinforcement learning in MuJoCo.

sources.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip ... - CNBC
sources.snippet: A representative for the robotics company said that it is using Rockchip in Microduck due to "its on-board 1 TOPS NPU." TOPS, or tera operations per second, is a measure of AI computing performance.
